headline_seed: Trump administration proposes more than $100K fee for H-1B visas - Politico
draft_text:
The Trump administration proposed a $103,265 fee on H-1B visa petitions Monday, per Politico and CNN — up from roughly $3,000 previously.
A federal judge struck down an earlier $100,000 version in June.
A 30-day comment period opens now.

And that's the mews.
